sentences.text: It appears that the applicant is in jail in  connection with the present crime since 3.7.2019.
His  antecedents are clear.
He is owner of small pan shop at  village Ranjangaon, Tq. Gangapur.
During the course of  the raid all contraband articles came to be seized by the
raiding
party .
The applicant has permanent residence  at village Ranjangaon, Tq. Gangapur.
He is available for  trial.
Investigation is almost over for all practical  purposes.
Thus, by imposing certain conditions, I am  inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
Hence, following  order.
ORDER 1.
The application is hereby allowed.

2. The applicant Gulab Atmaram Patil in connection with Crime No.70 of 2019 registered with Daulatabad Police Station, District Aurangabad for the offences punishable under sections 188, 273,
328 of IPC and under section 59 of the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006 be released on bail on furnishing P.B. of Rs.15,000/-(Rs. Fifteen Thousand) with one surety of the like amount on the following conditions :-
aaa/-
3 BA 937.2019.odt a] The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
b] The applicant shall attend the concerned police station once in a week i.e. on every Sunday between 8 am to 11 am till filing of the charge sheet.
3. Application is accordingly disposed off.
